page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the ecs.se1.2xlarge demonstrates modest processing capabilities. Its single-core and multi-core CPU performance in stress-ng and Geekbench falls into the bottom 25% tier. However, it maintains average performance in large-block memory bandwidth tests, with read speeds of 39.75 GB/sec and write speeds of 36.51 GB/sec. Database operations, such as Redis SET, also perform at an average level, reaching 5.94 million operations per second. Conversely, single-threaded compression and decompression tasks show poor performance, placing in the bottom 10%.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.se1.2xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring a larger memory footprint without demanding high-frequency compute power. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures stable execution, though the older Intel Xeon architecture limits its suitability for modern high-throughput tasks. This instance is best suited for memory-intensive applications such as caching layers, medium-sized databases, and basic enterprise applications that benefit from 64 GB of RAM but do not require local NVMe storage or high-speed networking.
